about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a full-stack developer focused on shipping clean, maintainable products that perform well in production. I work across the stack — from designing the interface in Figma to deploying the API.
about.p2: Currently pursuing a postgraduate specialization in Full Stack Development at PUC-RS while expanding into AI and digital automation. I'm fluent in English and ready to collaborate with international teams remotely.
about.p3: Outside the editor, I'm a fast learner who values clear communication, ownership, and shipping. I treat every project as a long-term partnership.
